review.posthog_relevance: Adds a distinct error classification and recovery guidance for database permission failures in warehouse ingestion, allowing PostHog users to distinguish permission errors from other CDC failures and potentially resolve them without support intervention.
review.reason: The chunk adds a new error category and recovery guidance for permission-related failures, and updates tests to reflect the new classification. This represents a substantive, bounded improvement in error handling and recovery for warehouse ingestion, though the chunk lacks the complete implementation and backend changes, preventing a tier 3 assessment.
review.uncertainty: The chunk does not include the implementation of the classification change, the removal of the old retryable behavior, or the complete context of the warehouse ingestion workflow. It also lacks the corresponding backend changes that would actually use the new PERMISSION_DENIED category.
